summary: Nothing further this turn: about two minutes of allocation remain, which cannot cover another verified execution, and every pending receipt has already been interpreted. Final state - three sourced investigations, each witnessed twice by independent clean-copy runs. (1) Explicit leadership transfer accepts a caller-named non-voter: the future reports success while the named target never leads and the incumbent is forced to re-elect (the successor's identity varies with schedule). (2) One allowed StoreLogs error in the conflict-truncation window wedges the follower permanently (store truncated to its pre-conflict last index, certificate pinned at the deleted suffix, no further store attempt, commit stalled, control converging in the same run), costs exactly one slot of commitment-quorum margin, and is repaired only by a restart or by a leader snapshot install, which under defaults needs roughly the trailing-window of further entries. (3) The growth sequence the library documents commits the change and returns a successful future while permanently removing the sole node's leadership and write availability; no in-process API call undoes it, and the staged AddNonvoter form keeps the cluster serving. Boundaries, counterevidence, limitations, reproductions and the durable negative result (a stale certificate cannot win an election) are all recorded against their receipts.
